label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.9 a.2 co: Aquinas distinguishes mutability through POTENCY_1…
locator: I q.9 a.2 co.: mutabile potest aliquid dici dupliciter
interpretation: The external channel is the creator's power to originate or withdraw creaturely esse; it is not asserted to be an intrinsic InPotency of the creature. This is an attributed metaphysical claim, not a formal identification of sustaining dependence with CausesIn or an assertion that arbitrary modal powers are causes.
